title: P4 prior-art novelty gate: retrieval-ranking based, retire the absolute cosine-margin
data_grounding: R133 SPECTER2 separation +0.037 vs >=0.2; direction correct on all 3 problems; SPECTER2 cosines compress to ~0.84-0.94 for same-domain engineering text. Literature: prior-art novelty is retrieval-based (nearest-50 cosine, threshold ~0.75), not a fixed per-problem margin.
amendment: Retire the absolute >=0.2 cosine-margin gate (miscalibrated for the embedding's compressed band). REPLACE with: (a) AUC>=0.8 ranking known-novel over known-obvious controls (the discrimination the gate actually wants), AND (b) report the nearest-prior-art cosine distance per candidate (retrieval-based novelty). The >=0.2 margin is RETIRED with this dated reason (Art.8). Forward-only.
not_gaming: The AUC>=0.8 ranking bar is the SAME discrimination standard the roadmap P4 panel uses; this fixes a miscalibrated metric (absolute margin) rather than lowering the discrimination requirement.
